messages:
Maya K: Hey team — quick check for tomorrow's interview (10:00 PST with candidate A). Two quick asks: 1) confirm room/Zoom + calendar invite owner, 2) clarify rubric weighting for system design vs coding vs collaboration. I can take debrief lead unless someone else wants it.

Samir Patel: I can cover system-design scoring. Zoom link is in the calendar invite I created: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 — added the panel. Not sure about onsite room access though.

Jordan: Onsite room is Conf B (3rd floor). Lina has the keycard list — @Lina Chen can you confirm Samir can get in?

Lina Chen: Yep Samir is on the access list. I'll unlock at 9:50 and leave a sign. :thumbsup:

Maya K: Thanks! About the rubric — current default is 40% system design, 35% coding, 25% collaboration/fit. This loop is heavier on infra, thinking of shifting to 45/30/25. Thoughts?

Samir Patel: 45/30/25 makes sense for this role. Reminder: coding uses the 1-4 scale in the rubric. Quick example below for scoring calc.

Samir Patel: ```
System Design: 4
Coding: 3
Collab: 4
Total weighted = 4*0.45 + 3*0.30 + 4*0.25 = 3.65
```

Jordan: Also please add an extra prompt about cache invalidation during the design section — flagged it on the interview sheet.

Maya K: Added the cache prompt to the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/xyz.

InterviewBot: Reminder: Candidate A — pre-interview questionnaire received. Don't forget to submit debrief within 24h after the loop: https://redwood.internal/hiring/debrief.

Lina Chen: One more logistical note — please don't fill the rubric in the Google doc. Use the hiring app form instead: https://hiring.internal/reviews/new (it ties into score aggregation).

Samir Patel: ack. Also tagging @Jordan in case the coding exercise runs long and we need a follow-up thread.

Jordan: Will follow up if needed. I'll take notes on the coding portion and flag any gaps.

Maya K: Great — unless anyone objects I'll shift weighting to 45/30/25 and make myself calendar owner so I can add the onsite note. Objections now or I'll update.

Lina Chen: No objections.

Samir Patel: Good with me.

Jordan: Good.

Maya K: Updated rubric in the hiring app and changed calendar owner to me. Thanks y'all — see you tomorrow.
